title: Connection-Scoped Tabs & Responsive UI
description: Release v0.8.1 - Improved tab management with connection isolation, refactored API services, and enhanced responsive design for split-screen usage.
highlights: Connection-scoped tabs - each database connection now has its own isolated workspace
RAG Pipeline - AI-powered semantic search across your database tables
Responsive toolbar labels collapse to icons on medium screens (< 768px)
Generic APIService class for reusable API data synchronization
Automated release and documentation sync workflow

items.title: Connection-Scoped Tabs
items.description: Each database connection now maintains its own isolated set of tabs. Switching between connections no longer prompts to discard or migrate tabs.
details: Refactored workspace store to use `workspacesByConnection` map
Added `switchConnection` action for seamless connection switching
Removed the 'Unsaved Tabs' dialog - no longer needed

items.title: Tab Dirty State Indicator
items.description: Tabs now show a minimal amber dot indicator when they have unsaved changes.
details: Added `isDirty` flag to Tab interface
Engine changes automatically update tab dirty state

items.title: RAG Pipeline for Database Knowledge
items.description: Implemented a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that indexes database tables for AI-powered semantic search.
details: RAGService with markdown and table data chunking
Vector embeddings stored in SurrealDB `knowledge_chunk` table
Hybrid search combining vector similarity and keyword matching

items.title: Responsive UI for Split-Screen
items.description: The interface now adapts beautifully to split-screen and medium-sized windows.
details: Toolbar labels collapse to icons on screens narrower than 768px
Sidebar minimum width reduced to 180px with intelligent capping
Tooltips preserved for discoverability in icon-only mode

items.title: Generic APIService for Data Sync
items.description: Created a reusable architecture for fetching and syncing external API data to SurrealDB.
details: StockService refactored for better reliability
Added WeatherService demonstration using Open-Meteo

items.title: Documentation & CI Fixes
items.description: Resolved critical issues with documentation rendering and release automation.
details: Fixed docs refresh issue (renamed /docs to /_docs)
Automated release workflow to trigger on push to changelogs
Resolved NoActiveSocket errors during service startup

items.title: Data Handling Fixes
items.description: Improved handling for specific data types and symbols.
details: Fixed stock symbols with dots (e.g., BRK.B) in SurrealDB IDs
Improved polling stability for live data updates

items.title: Known Issues
items.description: Points to be addressed in upcoming patches.
details: RAG indexing scaling for very large tables
Workspace backend persistence for the new connection model
